Binding.description:
Canonical name → dataset name, for dims and variables (``geo: market``).

Names that are not bound keep their dataset name. The binding is stored in the bundle
and reversed on every output by default.

BundleManifest.description:
The platform-signed manifest of a bundle (``manifest.json`` + ``manifest.sig``).

Binds tenant, run, base digest, overlay hash, spec hash, data hash and every
*destination* generation. URLs to a bundle are minted only after this signature checks.

CoordSummary.description:
Metadata summary of one coordinate (never the full array for large dims).

``values`` lists categorical levels when there are at most :attr:`MAX_LEVELS` of them;
ordered dims (time/integer) describe a range by ``start``/``end``/``size`` and whether
the coordinate is ``contiguous`` (no gaps at its frequency/step).
CoordSummary.title: CoordSummary

DataSchema.title: DataSchema

DataSchemaTemplate.description:
A DataSchema-shaped JSON template plus the settings parameters it depends on.

Resolution is pure and static: ``resolve(settings)`` extracts each declared parameter
from the settings (falling back to its default), checks its type/enum, renders the
:mod:`~mapi_spec.template` placeholders, deep-merges every matching ``case`` and
validates the result as a :class:`DataSchema`.
DataSchemaTemplate.title: DataSchemaTemplate

SignedPut.description:

``headers`` must be sent verbatim (they are part of the signature): typically
``content-type``, ``x-goog-if-generation-match: 0`` (write-once) and
``x-goog-content-length-range: 0,<max_bytes>``.
